usage: drive.py [-h]
                {preflight,contract,inspect,screen,variant,cassettevariant,mode,nav,up,settings,play,pause,resume,next,prev,seek,pref,clearpref,permit,shoot,tree,tap,logcat,overflows,reset,reload,restart,replay,call,emulate,window,probe,frames,timeline,profile,breakpoint}
                ...

positional arguments:
  {preflight,contract,inspect,screen,variant,cassettevariant,mode,nav,up,settings,play,pause,resume,next,prev,seek,pref,clearpref,permit,shoot,tree,tap,logcat,overflows,reset,reload,restart,replay,call,emulate,window,probe,frames,timeline,profile,breakpoint}
    preflight           detect host/flutter/adb/live-run at runtime and
                        recommend the next command (JSON on stdout, human
                        summary on stderr)
    contract            list the ext.nothingness.* extensions the running
                        build actually registered + their count (never
                        hardcode the number)
    cassettevariant     select cassette variant 1..7 (requires cassette screen
                        active)
    reset               force-stop + clear data + cold launch (refuses when a
                        live `flutter run` is attached; pass --force to
                        override)
    reload              hot reload via `flutter run` fifo
    restart             hot restart via `flutter run` fifo
    emulate             phone-frame the desktop app:
                        phone|small|tall|tiny|off|WxH
    window              set exact phone-frame size (B-042)
    probe               dump text+style of a keyed Text widget
    frames              frame-timing / jank summary
    timeline            VM timeline summary + agent.*/transport.* marked spans
    profile             CPU self-time profile via getCpuSamples (does NOT
                        pause the app)
    breakpoint          DANGER: set a TRUE VM breakpoint and capture
                        stack+watch. PAUSES the UI isolate (freezing ALL
                        ext.nothingness extensions) until it resumes in a
                        finally; NEVER run concurrently with another driver.
